audit_scope: Artifact hashes, temporal separation, independent arithmetic and source freeze; no evaluation target reopen or model refit
limits: Organic stockouts have no released true latent demand.
Artificial masked hourly scores are conditional on fully stocked days and repeated masks are dependent.
Hourly MAE chose a strongly downward-biased sparse-demand GBM.
Recovered forecasts did not beat raw LightGBM on fully-stocked validation or holdout WAPE.
These numerical F1/F2 stages measure no LLM benefit.
Native normalized sales and cost-index simulations must not be interpreted as retailer currency/physical units.
